_comment: Passed to the primary seat's Claude Code with --settings (wsp-473), written beside ~/.claude/settings.json by `wsp install`. These verbs check the caller's role themselves; the allow rule only gets the call to wsp.
_comment_guard: PreToolUse on Bash is the kill guard (wsp-691): wsp-session.sh refuses a pkill, killall or killing pgrep with an option after its first pattern (BSD getopt reads it as one more pattern: on 2026-11-19 `pkill -f "scripts/check.mjs" -P 0` ended every Claude session on the machine), one naming a bare common name (claude, node, wsp, compound-sup, compound-render, cargo), or a pkill pattern under 4 characters, and says to kill by pid. The command finds the script in the checkout or, on an executor, in ~/.claude/hooks; the same text is in every seat's settings and in the snippet, so where both hold it the two are one command and agree; a verifier or plain seat, which has no role file, is started with wsp-seat.settings.json, which holds only this hook.
